description: This file defines SwiftUI views and associated components for a macOS application, including a text view for transcripts with editing capabilities and a vibrant label view with tap recognition.

classes.name: Coordinator
classes.description: A coordinator class for managing NSTextView delegate methods within TranscriptTextView.

classes.name: ClickCatcher
classes.description: An NSView subclass that detects mouse clicks to trigger tap actions.

classes.name: TranscriptNSTextView
classes.description: A custom NSTextView subclass that handles special key events like return, escape, and command+return for sending and editing control.

methods.name: makeCoordinator
methods.description: Creates and returns a Coordinator instance for NSTextView delegate handling.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Constructs and configures an NSScrollView containing a custom NSTextView for transcript editing.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the NSScrollView's document view attributed string when the SwiftUI state changes.

methods.name: textDidBeginEditing
methods.description: Called when text editing begins in the NSTextView.

methods.name: textDidEndEditing
methods.description: Called when text editing ends in the NSTextView.

methods.name: textDidChange
methods.description: Called when the text in NSTextView changes; updates the bound text state.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates a label with attributed text in VibrantLabelView.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates label content in VibrantLabelView when the attributed text changes.

methods.name: mouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse click events in ClickCatcher to trigger tap callbacks.

methods.name: becomeFirstResponder
methods.description: Handles focus acquisition in TranscriptNSTextView, triggering onBeginEditing callback.

methods.name: resignFirstResponder
methods.description: Handles focus loss in TranscriptNSTextView, triggering onEndEditing callback.

methods.name: keyDown
methods.description: Intercepts key presses to handle return, escape, command+return, shift+return, and delegates other keys.
